# Clerk Next.js patterns: middleware, Server Actions, caching

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @clerk's official guide for advanced Next.js auth patterns: server vs client auth (`await auth()` vs hooks), public-first vs protected-first middleware strategies, protecting Server Actions and API routes (401 vs 403), user-scoped caching pitfalls, passing custom JWTs to external APIs via `getToken()`, and manual JWT verification for standalone API servers.
